title: Break same-millisecond ties by id DESC in getLatestAudioImport
body:
## Summary
`getLatestAudioImport` in `src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:44-47` orders rows by `createdAt DESC LIMIT 1` without a secondary `, id DESC` tie-breaker, unlike its sibling `getLatestAudioImportForSet` (`src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:52`).

## Description
In `src/lib/audio-import-db.ts`, `getLatestAudioImportForSet` (`:50-55`) uses `ORDER BY createdAt DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1` and `listLatestAudioImportsBySet` (`:65`) groups by `MAX(id)` so two import runs recorded within the same millisecond (`Date.now()`) deterministically resolve to the later insert. By contrast, `getLatestAudioImport` (`:44-47`) uses `SELECT * FROM audio_import_runs ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 1`, causing SQLite to return the earlier insert when two runs share a `createdAt` timestamp.

## Flow
`recordAudioImport` (`src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:36-41`) -> `INSERT INTO audio_import_runs` -> `getLatestAudioImport` (`src/lib/audio-import-db.ts:44-47`) -> `SELECT * FROM audio_import_runs ORDER BY createdAt DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1`.

## Expected impact
Eliminates non-deterministic or stale run selection when consecutive audio imports complete within the same millisecond.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `getLatestAudioImport` returns the older row when two imports share the same `createdAt` millisecond.
- **Before:** Inserting two runs at `createdAt = 1700000000000` (`first.id = 2`, `second.id = 3`) caused `getLatestAudioImport(db)?.id` to return `2` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/lib/audio-import-db.test.ts`).
- **After:** `getLatestAudioImport(db)?.id` returns `3` (`second.id`); 2/2 tests in `src/__tests__/lib/audio-import-db.test.ts` pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Reject path-traversing or multi-segment setId in POST /api/audio-gen
body:
## Summary
`POST /api/audio-gen` (`src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:52-135`) accepts caller-supplied `body.setId` without containment validation, allowing `..` traversal or nested path segments to reach `join(AUDIO_DIR, set.id)` and `writeFileSync` after calling the billed audio provider.

## Description
While `DELETE /api/audio-gen` validates `setId` via `removeSetDirectory(setId)` -> `resolveAudioPath(setId)` (`src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:223-230`), `POST /api/audio-gen` (`src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:68-121`) passes `body.setId` directly to `upsertSet` and `join(AUDIO_DIR, set.id)` after invoking `provider.generate(req)`. A `setId` such as `'../escape'` or `'nested/set'` triggers a paid provider call and writes files outside `<AUDIO_DIR>/<setId>`.

## Flow
`POST /api/audio-gen` (`src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:52`) -> `isSafeSetId(body.setId)` (`src/app/api/audio-gen/route.ts:19-24,68-73`) -> HTTP 400 before `upsertSet` or `provider.generate`.

## Expected impact
Blocks path traversal and multi-segment `setId` writes in `POST /api/audio-gen` before any DB mutation or billed provider call.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `POST /api/audio-gen` accepts `setId: '../escape'` with HTTP 200 and calls the provider.
- **Before:** `POST /api/audio-gen` with `setId: '../escape'` returned HTTP 200 and invoked `provider.generate` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/api/audio-gen-route.test.ts`).
- **After:** Rejects `'../escape'`, `'..\\escape'`, `'nested/set'`, and `'.'` with HTTP 400 and `0` provider calls; 10/10 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Surface list-levels load failure with retry in SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel
body:
## Summary
`SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel/index.tsx:36-50,165-175`) silently swallows `list-levels` HTTP failures and renders the empty state (`"No level design documents found"`) with no error message or retry action.

## Description
During initial mount (`index.tsx:41-49`), `fetch('/api/level-design?action=list-levels')` only updates `levelDocs` when `r.ok` is true and ignores `!r.ok` responses as well as network rejections (`catch {}`). When the API returns HTTP 500 or fails, `levelDocs` remains `[]` and the selector renders `"No level design documents found"`, conflating a server failure with an empty database.

## Flow
`loadLevels` (`SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel/index.tsx:40-63`) -> sets `levelsError` on `!r.ok` or rejection -> renders `role="alert"` banner with `Retry` button (`SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel/index.tsx:180-195`).

## Expected impact
Distinguishes level-list fetch failures from empty state and allows one-click recovery without reloading the page.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** When `list-levels` returns HTTP 503, `SpatialAudioGeneratorPanel` renders `"No level design documents found"` with no alert or retry button.
- **Before:** HTTP 503 on `list-levels` rendered `"No level design documents found"` and `queryByRole('alert')` was `null` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/audio/spatial-audio-sync-panel.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Renders `role="alert"` with the server error message and a `Retry` button that re-fetches `list-levels` and populates the level list; 2/2 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Preserve draft name and reset isCreating on failed scene creation in useAudioView
body:
## Summary
`handleCreateDoc` in `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/useAudioView.ts:153-164` unconditionally clears `newDocName` when `createDoc` returns `null` and lacks a `try / finally` around `await createDoc`, leaving `isCreating` permanently `true` if `createDoc` throws.

## Description
In `useAudioView.ts:153-164`, `handleCreateDoc` sets `setIsCreating(true)`, awaits `createDoc({ name: newDocName.trim() })`, and then clears `setNewDocName('')` outside `if (doc)`. When `createDoc` fails and returns `null`, the user's typed scene name is wiped; if `createDoc` rejects, `setIsCreating(false)` is skipped and the Create button stays disabled.

## Flow
`handleCreateDoc` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/useAudioView.ts:153-164`) -> `try { const doc = await createDoc(...); if (doc) { setActiveDocId(doc.id); setNewDocName(''); } } finally { setIsCreating(false); }`.

## Expected impact
Preserves user input on failed scene creation and guarantees `isCreating` resets on both null return and promise rejection.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Failed `createDoc` (`null` or rejection) wipes `newDocName` or leaves `isCreating` stuck at `true`.
- **Before:** Returning `null` from `createDoc` wiped `newDocName` to `''`, and a rejected `createDoc` left `isCreating === true` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/audio/audio-view-event-budget.test.tsx`).
- **After:** `newDocName` remains `'Boss Arena'` on failure and `isCreating` resets to `false` in `finally`; 3/3 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Settle buffered zone edits in handleGenerateSoundscape and render all reverb presets in SettingsTab
body:
## Summary
`handleGenerateSoundscape` in `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/useAudioView.ts:178-193` reads `activeDoc` without calling `settle()`, sending stale zone descriptions to the CLI prompt, while `SettingsTab.tsx:85-99` hardcodes only 4 of the 10 `ReverbPreset` options.

## Description
1. `handleGenerateAll` (`:166`) and `handleGenerateZoneCode` (`:195`) both call `const doc = settle() ?? activeDoc` so debounced text edits in `useBufferedAudioDoc` are flushed before building the CLI prompt. `handleGenerateSoundscape` (`:178-193`) omits `settle()`, so clicking Generate Soundscape within 300ms of editing a zone uses stale `zone` state and never flushes `commitDoc`.
2. `REVERB_PRESETS` (`src/lib/audio-scene-defaults.ts:11-22`) defines 10 presets (`none`, `small-room`, `large-hall`, `cave`, `outdoor`, `underwater`, `metal-corridor`, `stone-chamber`, `forest`, `custom`), which `ZoneCard.tsx:136` renders in full, whereas `SettingsTab.tsx:86` hardcodes `(['none', 'small-room', 'large-hall', 'outdoor'] as ReverbPreset[])`, making 6 presets impossible to select as the global reverb preset.

## Flow
1. `ZoneCard` edit -> `patchDoc` (`useBufferedAudioDoc`) -> `handleGenerateSoundscape` (`useAudioView.ts:178-193`) -> `const doc = settle() ?? activeDoc` -> resolves latest `zone` from `doc.zones`.
2. `REVERB_PRESETS` (`src/lib/audio-scene-defaults.ts:11`) -> `SettingsTab` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/SettingsTab.tsx:86-97`).

## Expected impact
Ensures soundscape generation prompts always include buffered zone edits and exposes all 10 `ReverbPreset` values in `SettingsTab`.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `handleGenerateSoundscape` does not flush buffered edits (`commitDoc` called 0 times), and `SettingsTab` renders only 4 of 10 reverb presets.
- **Before:** `commitDoc` was called `0` times before `handleGenerateSoundscape` built its prompt, and `SettingsTab` rendered 4 preset buttons (2 failing tests across `audio-view-event-budget.test.tsx` and `audio-text-debounce.test.tsx`).
- **After:** `settle()` flushes `commitDoc` (`1` call) and resolves the updated zone from `doc.zones`, and `SettingsTab` renders all 10 `REVERB_PRESETS`; 11/11 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Stop and disconnect replaced AudioBufferSourceNode on clip rebind in useSceneAudition
body:
## Summary
In `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/useSceneAudition.ts:90-94`, when an emitter's `clipUrl` changes while Listen mode is active (`h.clipUrl !== v.url`), `sync()` only calls `v.gain.disconnect()` without stopping `v.source` (`source.loop = true`) or disconnecting `v.source`, `v.filter`, and `v.panner`.

## Description
Each active emitter voice creates a looping `AudioBufferSourceNode` (`source.loop = true`, `:111`), a `GainNode`, a `BiquadFilterNode`, and a `StereoPannerNode` (`:101-120`). While the cleanup loop for removed emitters (`:82-86`) stops or disconnects nodes, the rebind branch at `:90-94` (`if (v && v.url !== h.clipUrl)`) only calls `v.gain.disconnect()` and drops `v` from `voicesRef`, leaving `v.source` decoding and looping indefinitely in the live `AudioContext`.

## Flow
`useSceneAudition` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/useSceneAudition.ts:13-19,91,117-125`) -> `disposeVoice(v)` stops `v.source` and disconnects `v.source`, `v.gain`, `v.filter`, and `v.panner` on both emitter removal and `clipUrl` rebind.

## Expected impact
Prevents leaked looping `AudioBufferSourceNode` instances and orphaned filter/panner subgraphs in the Web Audio graph when rebinding emitter clips.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Changing an emitter's `clipUrl` during active audition leaves the previous `AudioBufferSourceNode` running (`firstSource.stop` called 0 times).
- **Before:** Rebinding `clipUrl` from `/api/audio-assets/a` to `/api/audio-assets/b` called `firstSource.stop` `0` times (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/audio/scene-audition.test.tsx`).
- **After:** `disposeVoice` calls `stop()` and `disconnect()` on the replaced source, gain, filter, and panner nodes (`firstSource.stop` called `1` time); 3/3 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Associate form labels in AudioCodeGenPanel and add aria-pressed to ToolBtn and SettingsTab
body:
## Summary
`AudioCodeGenPanel.tsx:112-129` renders `<label>Module Name</label>` and `<label>API Macro</label>` without `htmlFor`/`id` associations, and toggle buttons in `ToolBtn.tsx:8-11` and `SettingsTab.tsx:87-92` omit `type="button"` and `aria-pressed`.

## Description
1. In `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioCodeGenPanel.tsx:112-129`, the `Module Name` and `API Macro` text inputs are preceded by unlinked `<label>` elements, so screen readers and `getByLabelText` cannot resolve the controls.
2. In `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/ToolBtn.tsx:8-11` and `src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/SettingsTab.tsx:87-92`, active tool/preset toggle buttons communicate selection state only via visual border/color classes without `aria-pressed={active}` or `type="button"`.

## Flow
`AudioCodeGenPanel` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioCodeGenPanel.tsx:112-129`) -> links `htmlFor`/`id`; `ToolBtn` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioScenePainter/ToolBtn.tsx:8-11`) and `SettingsTab` (`src/components/modules/content/audio/AudioView/SettingsTab.tsx:87-92`) -> set `type="button"` and `aria-pressed`.

## Expected impact
Exposes accessible names for codegen configuration inputs and programmatic toggle states (`aria-pressed`) for scene painter tools and reverb preset buttons.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `screen.getByLabelText('Module Name')` throws and `ToolBtn` has `aria-pressed === null`.
- **Before:** `getByLabelText('Module Name')` threw `TestingLibraryElementError` and `ToolBtn` `getAttribute('aria-pressed')` returned `null` (2 failing tests across `AudioCodeGenPanelCopy.test.tsx` and `AudioScenePainter.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Both inputs resolve via `getByLabelText` and `ToolBtn` / `SettingsTab` toggle buttons expose `aria-pressed="true"`/`"false"`; 17/17 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Remove dead zoneInits allocation and unused parameters in audio-codegen
body:
## Summary
`src/lib/audio-codegen.ts` contains a dead `zoneInits` `.map().join()` allocation (`:160-185`), an unused `EmitterType` type import (`:16`), and 5 private codegen helpers with unused `moduleName` parameters (`:139,309,435,590,751`), producing 7 ESLint warnings.

## Description
In `src/lib/audio-codegen.ts`, `generateAttenuationCpp` (`:160-185`) allocates and joins a multi-line C++ string `zoneInits` over `doc.zones` that is never interpolated or returned; `EmitterType` (`:16`) is imported but never referenced; and private helpers `generateSoundCueHeader`, `generateSoundPoolManagerCpp`, `generateEmitterActorCpp`, `generateReplicationCpp`, and `generateSoundscapeTriggerCpp` accept `_moduleName` / `moduleName` parameters with zero consumers (`git grep` across `src/` shows all 5 are module-private to `src/lib/audio-codegen.ts`).

## Flow
`generateAudioSceneCode` (`src/lib/audio-codegen.ts:865-888`) -> calls private helpers without unused `moduleName` argument and without allocating dead `zoneInits` in `generateAttenuationCpp`.

## Expected impact
Removes dead string allocation on every codegen pass and brings `npx eslint src/lib/audio-codegen.ts` from 7 warnings to 0 while preserving byte-for-byte identical C++ output.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `npx eslint src/lib/audio-codegen.ts` reports 7 `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` warnings including dead `zoneInits` computation.
- **Before:** `npx eslint src/lib/audio-codegen.ts` reported `7 problems (0 errors, 7 warnings)`.
- **After:** `npx eslint src/lib/audio-codegen.ts` reports `0 errors, 0 warnings`, and `src/__tests__/lib/audio-scene-audition.test.ts` (20/20 tests) verifies the generated C++ SHA-256 digest is unchanged.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Normalize enemy groups by archetype and level in scenarioSignature
body:
## Summary
`scenarioSignature` in `src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx:36-45` serializes `s.enemies` in raw array order (`s.enemies.map(e => `${e.archetypeId}:${e.count}:${e.level}`).join(',')`) without sorting or aggregating duplicate `(archetypeId, level)` rows, triggering a false `"Scenario changed since the baseline was pinned"` banner on equivalent encounters.

## Description
While `scenarioSignature` sorts `s.playerAbilities` (`[...s.playerAbilities].map(a => a.id).sort().join(',')`), it leaves `s.enemies` in insertion order and does not combine rows that share `(archetypeId, level)`. Reordering two enemy groups or splitting `3x melee-grunt (Lvl 5)` into `1x melee-grunt (Lvl 5)` + `2x melee-grunt (Lvl 5)` produces a different signature for the exact same simulated encounter.

## Flow
`scenarioSignature` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx:36-52`) -> aggregates `s.enemies` counts by `${e.archetypeId}:${e.level}`, sorts keys, and deduplicates `s.playerAbilities` -> `scenarioMismatch` (`index.tsx:164-167`).

## Expected impact
Eliminates false-positive scenario-mismatch warnings when comparing a candidate run against a pinned baseline with reordered or split enemy groups.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Reordering or splitting identical enemy groups across rows causes `CombatSimulatorView` to render the `"Scenario changed since the baseline was pinned"` mismatch warning.
- **Before:** Rendering `CombatSimulatorView` with a baseline of `[1x ranged-archer Lvl 5, 3x melee-grunt Lvl 5]` and a candidate of `[1x melee-grunt Lvl 5, 2x melee-grunt Lvl 5, 1x ranged-archer Lvl 5]` rendered the mismatch banner (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Equivalent encounters produce identical signatures (no warning banner), while changing total enemy count (`4x melee-grunt`) still triggers the warning; 10/10 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Filter selectedAbilities against catalog in ScenarioBuilder header and bulk controls
body:
## Summary
`ScenarioBuilder` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/ScenarioBuilder.tsx:96-116`) displays `({selectedAbilities.length}/{abilities.length})` and disables `Select all` when `selectedAbilities.length === abilities.length`, whereas `index.tsx:108-111` (`playerAbils`) and the per-group counters (`ScenarioBuilder.tsx:123-124`) filter `abilities` by `selectedAbilities.includes(a.id)`.

## Description
`CombatSimulatorView` initializes `selectedAbilities` with 5 hardcoded default IDs (`index.tsx:82-84`). When `abilities` has fewer items or contains custom catalog abilities not in the default list, the header counter (`ScenarioBuilder.tsx:97`) displays raw `selectedAbilities.length` (e.g., `(5/0)` or `(5/2)`), and when `abilities.length === 5` with 4 default abilities and 1 unselected custom ability, `selectedAbilities.length === abilities.length` (`5 === 5`) disables the `Select all` button even though the custom ability is unselected.

## Flow
`ScenarioBuilder` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/ScenarioBuilder.tsx:42,96-118`) -> computes `selectedCount = abilities.filter(a => selectedAbilities.includes(a.id)).length` -> drives header readout `({selectedCount}/{abilities.length})`, `Select all` (`disabled={abilities.length === 0 || selectedCount === abilities.length}`), and `Clear` (`disabled={selectedCount === 0}`).

## Expected impact
Keeps the `ScenarioBuilder` header counter and `Select all` / `Clear` buttons in exact parity with `playerAbils` and per-group counters.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** With 2 catalog abilities (`1` selected, `4` stale default IDs in `selectedAbilities`), `ScenarioBuilder` renders `(5/2)` instead of `(1/2)`, and with 5 catalog abilities (`4` selected, `1` unselected) `Select all` is disabled.
- **Before:** `screen.getByText('(1/2)')` failed (rendered `(5/2)`) and `Select all` was disabled at `(4/5)` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Header renders `(1/2)` and `(4/5)` and keeps `Select all` enabled until all catalog abilities are selected; 11/11 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Disable Run button and show inline status when abilities are cleared or config is missing
body:
## Summary
In `src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx:119-120,204-207`, the `Run` button only checks `disabled={isSimulating || !tuning}` even though `handleRun` requires `defaultConfig` and `gear`, and clearing all abilities in `ScenarioBuilder` (`selectedCount === 0`) leaves the `Run` button enabled with no empty-selection feedback.

## Description
1. `handleRun` (`index.tsx:120`) silently returns early if `!tuning || !defaultConfig || !gear`, yet the header `Run` button (`:206`) is only disabled when `isSimulating || !tuning`.
2. When catalog abilities are loaded (`abilities.length > 0`) and the user clicks `Clear` in `ScenarioBuilder`, `selectedCount` becomes `0` (`playerAbils` is `[]`), but `ScenarioBuilder` renders no inline guidance and `Run` remains enabled.

## Flow
`ScenarioBuilder` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/ScenarioBuilder.tsx:164-168`) -> renders `role="status"` message `"Select at least one ability to run the simulation"` when `abilities.length > 0 && selectedCount === 0`; `CombatSimulatorView` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/index.tsx:119-122,204`) -> computes `canRun` and disables the `Run` button when `!canRun`.

## Expected impact
Prevents silent no-op clicks when `defaultConfig` or `gear` is missing and gives clear inline feedback while disabling `Run` when all abilities are cleared.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Clicking `Clear` when abilities exist leaves `Run 1000 Fights` enabled with no status message, and `defaultConfig = null` also leaves `Run 1000 Fights` enabled.
- **Before:** After clicking `Clear`, `queryByText(/Select at least one ability/i)` was `null` and `runBtn.disabled` was `false` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Clearing abilities renders the status hint and disables `Run`, re-selecting abilities re-enables `Run`, and `defaultConfig = null` disables `Run`; 12/12 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Clear copy feedback timer on unmount and reset Copied state on clipboard failure
body:
## Summary
`FightReportCardPanel` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/FightReportCardPanel.tsx:26-34`) schedules an untracked `window.setTimeout` on copy without cleaning up on unmount or re-trigger, and its `catch` block leaves `copied` stuck at `true` if a subsequent clipboard write rejects.

## Description
In `FightReportCardPanel.tsx:26-34`, `handleCopy` calls `window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), UI_TIMEOUTS.copyFeedback)` without storing the timer ID in a ref or clearing it in a `useEffect` unmount cleanup. Moreover, if the user clicks `Copy` once (succeeding and setting `copied = true`) and clicks again while `copied` is still `true` and `navigator.clipboard.writeText` rejects, the empty `catch` block leaves the button displaying `'Copied'` despite the failed clipboard write.

## Flow
`FightReportCardPanel` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/FightReportCardPanel.tsx:23-50`) -> tracks timer in `copyTimerRef`, clears it on unmount and before each copy attempt, and calls `setCopied(false)` in `catch`.

## Expected impact
Prevents leaked timers across unmounts/rapid clicks and ensures a failed clipboard write never leaves stale `'Copied'` success feedback.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** A rejected clipboard write after a successful copy leaves the button label stuck on `'Copied'`, and unmounting does not call `clearTimeout`.
- **Before:** Rejecting `writeText` on the second click left the button text as `'Copied'` and unmounting did not call `clearTimeout` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/components/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx`).
- **After:** Rejected copy immediately resets the button to `'Copy'` and unmount clears the pending timer; 13/13 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Improve ScenarioBuilder and DistributionChart keyboard and screen-reader accessibility
body:
## Summary
`ScenarioBuilder.tsx`, `AbilityHeatmap.tsx`, and `DistributionChart.tsx` contain 4 sub-12px font classes (`text-[10px]` / `text-[9px]`) violating WCAG 1.4.4 (`no-restricted-syntax`), an unassociated `Gear` `<label>`/`<select>`, ability toggle buttons without `aria-pressed`, unlabeled enemy-group remove (`×`) buttons, and hover-only histogram bar tooltips inaccessible to keyboard focus.

## Description
1. `npx eslint src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView` flags 4 WCAG 1.4.4 legibility floor warnings: `AbilityHeatmap.tsx:54` (`text-[10px]`), `DistributionChart.tsx:74` (`text-[9px]`), and `ScenarioBuilder.tsx:139,144` (`text-[10px]`).
2. In `ScenarioBuilder.tsx`, `<label>Gear</label>` (`:67`) lacks `htmlFor`/`id` association with `<select>` (`:68`); ability buttons (`:148-158`) lack `type="button"` and `aria-pressed`; and enemy remove buttons (`:220-226`) render raw `×` without `aria-label` or `type="button"`.
3. In `DistributionChart.tsx:38-45`, histogram bucket bars expose their `min-max: count` readout only via `group-hover:block` with no `tabIndex`, `aria-label`, or `group-focus-within:block`.

## Flow
`ScenarioBuilder.tsx` (`:67-76,138-162,217-236`), `AbilityHeatmap.tsx` (`:54`), and `DistributionChart.tsx` (`:37-49,74`) -> associate `Gear` label, add `aria-pressed` and `Remove enemy group N` labels, add `tabIndex={0}` / `aria-label` / `group-focus-within:block` to histogram bars, and replace sub-12px classes with `text-2xs`.

## Expected impact
Resolves all 4 ESLint WCAG 1.4.4 warnings in `CombatSimulatorView` and makes `ScenarioBuilder` controls and `DistributionChart` bars accessible to screen readers and keyboard navigation.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `getByLabelText('Gear')` throws, ability buttons lack `aria-pressed`, enemy remove buttons lack accessible names, histogram bars lack `tabIndex`/`aria-label`, and ESLint reports 4 legibility warnings.
- **Before:** 1 failing accessibility test in `CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx` and 4 ESLint `no-restricted-syntax` warnings across `ScenarioBuilder.tsx`, `AbilityHeatmap.tsx`, and `DistributionChart.tsx`.
- **After:** 14/14 tests pass in `CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx` and `npx eslint` on all touched files reports `0 errors, 0 warnings`.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Disable TuningSlidersPanel Reset at default and handle negative/non-finite numbers in formatNumber
body:
## Summary
`TuningSlidersPanel` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/TuningSlidersPanel.tsx:23-28`) keeps the `Reset` button enabled even when all sliders already match `defaultTuning` (or when `defaultTuning` is `null`), and `formatNumber` in `helpers.ts:7-11` fails to abbreviate negative thousands/millions or guard non-finite numbers.

## Description
1. In `TuningSlidersPanel.tsx:23-28`, `Reset` has no `disabled` state when `defaultTuning` is `null` or when every slider in `TUNING_SLIDERS` already equals `defaultTuning`, giving users no visual cue whether tuning overrides are active vs at default.
2. In `helpers.ts:7-11`, `formatNumber(n)` checks `n >= 1_000_000` and `n >= 1_000` instead of `Math.abs(n)` and does not guard `!Number.isFinite(n)`, so `formatNumber(-1500)` returns `"-1500"` instead of `"-1.5k"` and `formatNumber(NaN)` returns `"NaN"`.

## Flow
`TuningSlidersPanel` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/TuningSlidersPanel.tsx:18-31`) -> computes `isAtDefault` across `TUNING_SLIDERS` and sets `disabled={isAtDefault}` on `Reset`; `formatNumber` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/helpers.ts:7-13`) -> guards `!Number.isFinite(n)` and checks `Math.abs(n)`.

## Expected impact
Provides clear disabled/enabled affordance on the `TuningSlidersPanel` `Reset` button and consistent compact number formatting across positive, negative, and non-finite values.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `Reset` is enabled when `tuning` equals `defaultTuning`, and `formatNumber(-1500)` returns `'-1500'`.
- **Before:** `resetBtn.disabled` was `false` at default tuning and `formatNumber(-1500)` returned `'-1500'` (2 failing tests in `src/__tests__/components/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView.test.tsx`).
- **After:** `Reset` is disabled at default tuning and enabled when any slider diverges, and `formatNumber` formats `'-1.5k'`, `'-2.5M'`, and `'0'` for `NaN`; 16/16 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Expose healingMul in TUNING_SLIDERS and COMBAT_METRICS glossary
body:
## Summary
`TuningOverrides` (`src/types/combat-simulator.ts:89`) defines `healingMul: number`, which the combat engine and test fixtures populate, but `TUNING_SLIDERS` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/constants.ts:33-41`) and `COMBAT_METRICS` (`src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`) omit `healingMul`.

## Description
`TuningOverrides` has 8 fields (`playerHealthMul`, `playerDamageMul`, `playerArmorMul`, `enemyHealthMul`, `enemyDamageMul`, `critMultiplierMul`, `armorEffectivenessWeight`, `healingMul`), but `TUNING_SLIDERS` in `constants.ts:33-41` only renders 7 sliders, omitting `healingMul`. Adding `healingMul` to `TUNING_SLIDERS` requires adding a matching `healingMul` entry in `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts` (enforced by `src/__tests__/lib/combat/metric-glossary.test.ts`), which is outside `combat-simulator`'s declared `file_paths`.

## Flow
`TUNING_SLIDERS` (`src/components/modules/evaluator/CombatSimulatorView/constants.ts:33-41`) -> `TuningSlidersPanel` (`TuningSlidersPanel.tsx:31-38`) -> `MetricLabel` (`src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`).

## Expected impact
Allows designers to tune `healingMul` from `TuningSlidersPanel` alongside the other 7 `TuningOverrides` multipliers once `metric-glossary.ts` is updated in tandem.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `TUNING_SLIDERS` has 7 entries while `TuningOverrides` has 8 keys (`healingMul` omitted).
- **Before:** `TUNING_SLIDERS.length === 7` (`healingMul` absent in `constants.ts:33-41` and `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts:102-144`).
- **After:** Deferred to backlog because updating `src/lib/combat/metric-glossary.ts` crosses outside `combat-simulator`'s declared `file_paths`.
- **Method:** `inspect`
- **Result:** `open`
- **Gate:** `scope`

title: Break reviewed_at ties by id in getAllReviewHistory
body:
## Summary
`getAllReviewHistory` in `src/lib/feature-matrix-db.ts:828-837` orders `review_snapshots` by `reviewed_at DESC` in `ROW_NUMBER()` and `reviewed_at ASC` in the outer query without breaking ties by `id`, unlike `getReviewHistory` (`:811,814`), `captureReviewSnapshot` (`:707`), `getLatestReviewDelta` (`:759`), and `pruneReviewSnapshots` (`:782`).

## Description
Every single-module snapshot query in `src/lib/feature-matrix-db.ts` breaks `reviewed_at` ties deterministically using `id` (`ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC, id DESC` when selecting recent snapshots and `ORDER BY reviewed_at ASC, id ASC` when restoring chronological order). By contrast, `getAllReviewHistory` (`:831,836`) uses `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_id ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC)` and `ORDER BY module_id, reviewed_at ASC`. When a legacy snapshot (`project_id = ''`) and a project-owned snapshot share the same `reviewed_at` timestamp, `getAllReviewHistory` can select the older snapshot at the window boundary (`rn <= limit`) and disagree with `getReviewHistory`.

## Flow
`getAllReviewHistory` (`src/lib/feature-matrix-db.ts:821-846`) -> `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY module_id ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC, id DESC)` -> outer `ORDER BY module_id, reviewed_at ASC, id ASC`.

## Expected impact
Guarantees deterministic window selection and chronological ordering in `getAllReviewHistory` that matches `getReviewHistory` on identical `reviewed_at` timestamps.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** When two snapshots in the read scope share `reviewed_at`, `getAllReviewHistory(1, projectId)` selects the older `id` (`102`) while `getReviewHistory(MODULE, 1, projectId)` selects the newer `id` (`103`).
- **Before:** `getAllReviewHistory(1, 'proj-tie')` returned `[102]` while `getReviewHistory(MODULE, 1, 'proj-tie')` returned `[103]` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/lib/feature-matrix-review-history.test.ts`).
- **After:** Both return `[103]` (`implemented = 4`); 12/12 tests in `src/__tests__/lib/feature-matrix-review-history.test.ts` pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Guard rowToLifecycle against malformed ue_assets JSON and rowToEntity against non-object payloads
body:
## Summary
In `src/lib/catalog-db.ts`, `rowToLifecycle` (`:27-36`) calls `JSON.parse((row.ue_assets as string) || '[]')` without `try / catch` or `Array.isArray` validation, and `rowToEntity` (`:123-143`) does not guard against valid non-object JSON values such as `'null'` or `'[]'`.

## Description
1. Unlike `safeParseJsonArray` in `src/lib/feature-matrix-db.ts:208-216` or `rowToEntity` in `src/lib/catalog-db.ts:127-135`, `rowToLifecycle` (`src/lib/catalog-db.ts:32`) parses `row.ue_assets` with a bare `JSON.parse`, so a single corrupt `ue_assets` value throws `SyntaxError` and breaks `listLifecycle` / `getLifecycle`. If `row.ue_assets` contains valid non-array JSON (e.g. `'{"path":"x"}'`), `ueAssets` is returned as a non-array object.
2. In `rowToEntity` (`:128-140`), if `row.data` contains `'null'` or `'[]'`, `JSON.parse` succeeds without throwing, and `{ ...entity, id: entityId, catalogId }` produces an incomplete object missing `name`, `categoryPath`, `tags`, and `lifecycle`.

## Flow
`rowToLifecycle` (`src/lib/catalog-db.ts:27-49`) -> wraps `JSON.parse` in `try / catch`, verifies `Array.isArray(parsed)`, and logs `logger.warn` on fallback to `[]`; `rowToEntity` (`src/lib/catalog-db.ts:132-145`) -> throws into fallback catch block when `parsed` is null, primitive, or array.

## Expected impact
Prevents malformed `ue_assets` JSON or non-object `catalog_entities.data` JSON from crashing catalog reads or returning malformed entity shapes.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `rowToLifecycle` throws `SyntaxError` on `ue_assets: '{broken'`, and `rowToEntity` with `data: 'null'` omits `name`, `categoryPath`, `tags`, and `lifecycle`.
- **Before:** 2 failing tests in `src/__tests__/lib/catalog-db.test.ts` (`SyntaxError` in `rowToLifecycle` and missing required fields in `rowToEntity`).
- **After:** `rowToLifecycle` returns `ueAssets: []` with a `logger.warn` and `rowToEntity` returns the complete fallback entity; 4/4 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Key ensureTable memoization on live Database instance in catalog-db and pipeline-db
body:
## Summary
`src/lib/catalog-db.ts` (`:8-24,101-116`) and `src/lib/pipeline-db.ts` (`:7-22`) cache boolean flags (`tableEnsured`, `entityTableEnsured`) instead of keying on the active `Database.Database` instance returned by `getDb()`, causing `SqliteError: no such table` whenever `getDb()` returns a new connection.

## Description
In `src/lib/db.ts:869-877`, `prepareCached` explicitly keys its memoization on the live `Database.Database` instance (`if (stmtCacheDb !== database)`) so connection swaps invalidate cached state. By contrast, `catalog-db.ts` (`let tableEnsured = false`, `let entityTableEnsured = false`) and `pipeline-db.ts` (`let tableEnsured = false`) flip module-global booleans to `true` after the first call. If `getDb()` subsequently returns a new `Database.Database` handle, `ensureTable()` and `ensureEntityTable()` return early without executing `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, and every query throws `SqliteError: no such table`.

## Flow
`ensureTable` / `ensureEntityTable` in `src/lib/catalog-db.ts:10-28,100-116` and `ensureTable` in `src/lib/pipeline-db.ts:8-24` -> compare `tableEnsuredDb === db` (`const db = getDb()`) and re-run DDL whenever the `Database.Database` instance changes.

## Expected impact
Eliminates `no such table` crashes across DB connection swaps while keeping DDL off the hot path on an unchanged singleton connection.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Swapping the `Database.Database` handle returned by `getDb()` after an initial write causes `upsertLifecycle`, `upsertEntity`, and `upsertTrack` to throw `SqliteError: no such table`.
- **Before:** Calling `upsertLifecycle` and `upsertTrack` after swapping `getDb()` threw `SqliteError: no such table: catalog_lifecycle` and `SqliteError: no such table: pipeline_tracks` (2 failing tests across `catalog-db.test.ts` and `pipeline-db.test.ts`).
- **After:** Both modules detect the new `Database.Database` instance, run `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, and complete the upserts; 8/8 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Memoize ensureCliSpendTables per Database instance and declare status column in CREATE TABLE
body:
## Summary
`ensureCliSpendTables()` in `src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:26-64` runs 5 `db.exec` DDL statements and `PRAGMA table_info(cli_spend)` on every call without per-connection memoization, and omits `status` from `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cli_spend`, causing a single `getSpendDashboard()` call to execute 20 DDL `db.exec` calls and 4 `PRAGMA table_info` queries.

## Description
Every exported function in `src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts` (`recordSpend`, `getBudgetConfig`, `setBudgetConfig`, `getBudgetStatus`, `getRecentSpend`, `getTaskTypeEstimate`, `getSpendDashboard`) calls `ensureCliSpendTables()`. Because `getSpendDashboard()` calls `ensureCliSpendTables()`, `getRecentSpend()`, and `getBudgetStatus()` (which in turn calls `getBudgetConfig()`), a single dashboard read invokes `ensureCliSpendTables()` 4 times. Furthermore, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cli_spend` (`:29-43`) omits `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed'`, forcing an `ALTER TABLE` on every fresh database.

## Flow
`ensureCliSpendTables` (`src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:25-62`) -> checks `if (cliSpendEnsuredDb === db) return;`, declares `status` directly in `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cli_spend`, retains the idempotent `PRAGMA table_info(cli_spend)` check for legacy DBs on first run, and records `cliSpendEnsuredDb = db`.

## Expected impact
Reduces redundant DDL `db.exec` calls during `getSpendDashboard()` on an initialized connection from 20 to 0 (and `PRAGMA table_info` queries from 4 to 0).

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Calling `getSpendDashboard()` on an already-initialized connection executes `db.exec` 20 times.
- **Before:** `vi.spyOn(getDb(), 'exec')` recorded `20` calls during a single `getSpendDashboard()` invocation (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/lib/cli-spend-db.test.ts`).
- **After:** `getSpendDashboard()` executes `0` `db.exec` calls on an already-ensured connection; 11/11 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Validate SQL identifiers in buildUpdateQuery and reject null bytes or nested setId in audio-asset-db
body:
## Summary
`buildUpdateQuery` in `src/lib/db-utils.ts:11-38` interpolates `tableName` and `allowedFields[].column` directly into `UPDATE ${tableName} SET ${column} = ?` without identifier validation, and `resolveAudioPath` / `removeSetDirectory` in `src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:223-265` do not reject null bytes (`\0`) or multi-segment `setId` values.

## Description
1. `buildUpdateQuery` (`src/lib/db-utils.ts:11-38`) parameterizes field values (`?`) but interpolates `tableName` and each `column` directly into the SQL string without checking `/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/`.Also, `src/lib/db-utils.ts` had zero unit tests in `src/__tests__/`.
2. In `src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts`, `resolveAudioPath(rel)` (`:223-230`) checks `rel.includes('..')` but does not reject null bytes (`\0`), and `removeSetDirectory(setId)` (`:251-265`) accepts `setId` containing path separators (`/` or `\\`), allowing deletion of arbitrary nested paths under `AUDIO_DIR` rather than a top-level `<setId>` directory.

## Flow
`buildUpdateQuery` (`src/lib/db-utils.ts:1-34`) -> `assertSqlIdentifier` validates `tableName` and each `column` against `/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/`; `resolveAudioPath` (`src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:223-230`) -> rejects `rel.includes('\0')`; `removeSetDirectory` (`src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:250-256`) -> rejects `/` and `\\` in `setId`.

## Expected impact
Prevents SQL identifier injection in `buildUpdateQuery`, blocks null-byte paths in `resolveAudioPath`, and restricts `removeSetDirectory` to single-segment set directories.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** `resolveAudioPath('s1/clip\0.mp3')` returns a non-null path, `removeSetDirectory('setA/sub')` resolves inside `AUDIO_DIR`, and `buildUpdateQuery` accepts `'audio_scenes; DROP TABLE audio_scenes--'` without throwing.
- **Before:** 2 failing security tests in `src/__tests__/lib/audio-asset-lifecycle.test.ts`.
- **After:** `resolveAudioPath` returns `null` on null bytes, `removeSetDirectory` refuses nested paths, and `buildUpdateQuery` throws `Invalid SQL identifier`; 13/13 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Clamp non-finite and negative numeric inputs in recordSpend and setBudgetConfig
body:
## Summary
`recordSpend` and `setBudgetConfig` in `src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:107-166` bind numeric fields directly into SQLite without guarding against `NaN`, `Infinity`, or negative values, allowing `NaN` to throw `SqliteError: NOT NULL constraint failed` and `Infinity` to permanently poison `SUM(cost_usd)` across the spend ledger.

## Description
In `better-sqlite3`, binding `NaN` to a numeric parameter binds SQLite `NULL`, which violates `NOT NULL` on `cost_usd`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cache_read_tokens`, `cache_creation_tokens`, and `duration_ms` in `cli_spend` (`src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:29-43`). Binding `Infinity` stores IEEE 754 `+Inf` in SQLite, causing `SUM(cost_usd)` in `getBudgetStatus()` (`:173`) and `getSpendDashboard()` (`:289`) to return `Infinity` forever. Negative numbers reduce cumulative spend and bypass budget limits.

## Flow
`recordSpend` (`src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:113-150`) -> sanitizes cost and token/duration fields via `nonNegativeFinite`; `setBudgetConfig` (`src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:165-178`) -> sanitizes `dailyLimitUsd` and `monthlyLimitUsd` via `nullableNonNegativeFinite`.

## Expected impact
Prevents `NOT NULL` crashes on `NaN` telemetry values and keeps `totalCostUsd`, `todaySpendUsd`, and `monthSpendUsd` finite and non-negative.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Passing `costUsd: NaN` to `recordSpend` throws `SqliteError: NOT NULL constraint failed: cli_spend.cost_usd`, and `costUsd: Infinity` makes `getSpendDashboard().totalCostUsd` non-finite.
- **Before:** `recordSpend({ costUsd: NaN, ... })` threw `SqliteError: NOT NULL constraint failed: cli_spend.cost_usd` (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/lib/cli-spend-db.test.ts`).
- **After:** Non-finite and negative values clamp to `0` (or `null` for budget limits) and `dash.totalCostUsd` remains finite (`0.5`); 12/12 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`

title: Declare project_id in CREATE TABLE build_history and favorite/promptHash in CREATE TABLE audio_assets
body:
## Summary
`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS build_history` in `src/lib/db.ts:235-251` omits `project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` (relying solely on the `if (needsMigrations)` `ALTER TABLE` probe at `:303-306`), and `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audio_assets` in `src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:42-53` omits `favorite` and `promptHash` (forcing two `ALTER TABLE` statements on every fresh DB).

## Description
1. In `src/lib/db.ts`, `feature_matrix` (`:104-109`) and `review_snapshots` (`:156-158`) explicitly declare `project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` in `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` so databases that skip migration probes (`user_version >= SCHEMA_VERSION`) still have the column. `build_history` (`:235-251`) was missed: `project_id` existed only in the `if (needsMigrations)` block at `:303-306`. If `build_history` is created when `user_version` is already `6`, `project_id` is missing.
2. In `src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:42-53,68-71`, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audio_assets` omits `favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` and `promptHash TEXT`, so `createAudioAssetDb` runs two `ALTER TABLE audio_assets ADD COLUMN` statements on every fresh database.

## Flow
`bootstrap` (`src/lib/db.ts:235-252`) -> includes `project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` in `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS build_history`; `createAudioAssetDb` (`src/lib/audio-asset-db.ts:42-55`) -> includes `favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` and `promptHash TEXT` in `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audio_assets`.

## Expected impact
Ensures `build_history` always has `project_id` even when `needsMigrations` is false and eliminates two `ALTER TABLE` executions on every fresh audio asset database.

## Evaluation
- **Claim:** Opening a DB pre-stamped at `user_version = 6` creates `build_history` without `project_id`, and `createAudioAssetDb` on a fresh `:memory:` DB executes `ALTER TABLE audio_assets`.
- **Before:** `PRAGMA table_info(build_history)` on a `user_version = 6` DB lacked `'project_id'` and `createAudioAssetDb` ran 2 `ALTER TABLE audio_assets` calls (1 failing test in `src/__tests__/lib/db-bootstrap-atomic.test.ts`).
- **After:** `build_history` includes `'project_id'` and `createAudioAssetDb` executes `0` `ALTER TABLE` statements on a fresh DB; 12/12 tests pass.
- **Method:** `gate`
- **Result:** `better`
- **Gate:** `none`
